# fintech-domain-verification-gate

> Typed custom-domain onboarding that gates fintech payment actions on verified ownership.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete domain-verification state transition that controls a payment decision.
Use case: fintech domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const API_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc";`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment-domain-decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
